title: Hearty Slovakian Pork Skewers
description: A nutty and springy Slovakian dish featuring mustard seeds and a showy flambe, this recipe is also ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly. It combines the flavors of pork, mustard, and spices for a delicious meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through.
While the skewers are cooking, heat the rum in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the skewers are done, brush the rum over the pork and ignite the rum for a flambe effect.
Sprinkle the mustard seeds over the skewers and serve immediately.
